title: Fourier regularity from the uniform $L^1$ norm
statement: Let $n\ge 0$ and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. Every nonempty-set Fourier coefficient of $f$ has absolute value at most the uniform average of $|f|$ on the cube.
